description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Cloud of Darkness)] and [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Cloud of Darkness)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Particle Blast after using equipped Dark abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Cloud of Darkness)], removes [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Cloud of Darkness)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Cloud of Darkness)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, abilities grant 25% more SB points, grants [Instant Cast 2] to the user when removed

description.name: Dual Particle Blast
description.text: Four single attacks (2.04 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user every second use

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
